verdict.rationale: Version-control friendliness and multi-person collaboration are fair questions for a game engine's editor tooling, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack covers source-control integration, mergeable or diffable asset/level formats, or built-in multi-user editing. The cited docs address Blueprints, C++, Python scripting, plugins, cooking, Remote Control and gameplay network replication, none of which are about team versioning workflows.
